in_arabic.name: غساسيني
in_arabic.meaning: غساس (ghasas) = avenger, vindicator, seeker of justice, one who avenges
in_arabic.long_meaning: The one who is an avenger or vindicator, one who seeks justice and avenges wrongs. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'ghasasa' which means to take revenge or to avenge.

in_urdu.name: غساسینی
in_urdu.meaning: غساس (ghasas) = استراحت می کنندہ (istrakh makannadah) = One who does not rest (from seeking justice)
in_urdu.long_meaning: The one who is relentless in seeking justice and never rests until wrongs are righted. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'ghasasa' which means to take revenge or to avenge, and the Urdu phrase 'istrakh makannadah' which means one who does not rest.

in_hindi.name: घससीनी
in_hindi.meaning: घसस (ghasas) = सत्यार्थी (satyaarthi) = Truth seeker, one who pursues justice
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is a truth seeker and one who pursues justice. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'ghasasa' which means to take revenge or to avenge, and the Hindi phrase 'satyaarthi' which means truth seeker.

in_pashto.name: غساسني
in_pashto.long_meaning: The one who is an enemy or adversary. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'ghasasa' which means to take revenge or to avenge, and the Pashto word 'dushman' which means enemy or adversary.

In Islamic teachings, being kind and generous is seen as an act of worship and an expression of faith. By focusing on the well-being of others, an individual embraces the principles of compassion and mercy, as exemplified by the Prophet Muhammad and other spiritual leaders of the faith.
